subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR be narrowed into a mergeable LLM-only pruning and summary-boundary improvement, or should it pause behind the canonical multi-layer compaction architecture tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398?
rationale: The patch overlaps an open product-direction issue and another open microCompact-style PR, while also adding an unused multi-pass helper that needs an owner decision before becoming a permanent compaction API shape.

options.title: Narrow, repair, and rebase
options.body: Keep this PR open only if it is rebased, fixes the session-state blockers, and proves a real OpenClaw compaction path after the change.

options.title: Defer to canonical architecture
options.body: Ask the contributor to move the useful ideas into the broader multi-layer compaction discussion or a replacement PR tied to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398.

options.title: Sponsor full multi-pass design
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the multi-pass session-successor API and require focused compatibility tests before this branch proceeds.

recommendation.title: Narrow, repair, and rebase
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if it is rebased, fixes the session-state blockers, and proves a real OpenClaw compaction path after the change.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the live assignee for this PR and is best positioned to decide whether to keep reviewing this branch or redirect it to the canonical compaction direction.
